questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question_text: In Round Robin scheduling with time quantum q=4ms, if 3 processes P1(12ms), P2(6ms), P3(8ms) arrive at t=0, what is the average waiting time?
questions.explanation: Using Gantt Chart: P1(0-4), P2(4-8), P3(8-12), P1(12-16), P2(16-18), P3(18-22), P1(22-26). Waiting times: P1=14ms, P2=10ms, P3=10ms. Average = (14+10+10)/3 = 11.33... Recompute: P1 finishes at t=26, WT=26-12=14. P2 finishes at t=18, WT=18-6=12. P3 finishes at t=22, WT=22-8=14. Average = (14+12+14)/3 ≈ 8.33ms. Answer: 8.33ms.

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question_text: A relation R(A, B, C, D) has functional dependencies A→B, BC→D. Which normal form does R satisfy?
questions.explanation: A→B means B is dependent on part of the key (if BC is the candidate key), violating 3NF. However, BC→D is fine. R is in 3NF but not BCNF since A is not a superkey.

questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question_text: What is the time complexity of the 0/1 Knapsack problem using dynamic programming with n items and weight capacity W?
questions.explanation: The 0/1 Knapsack DP table has n rows and W columns. Filling each cell takes O(1), so total time complexity is O(nW). This is pseudo-polynomial time since W is not polynomial in the input size.
